name: @pipeworx/mcp-finnhub

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a real-time stock quote including current price, change, and volume. Example: get_quote({ symbol: "AAPL" })

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Get recent news articles about a company within a date range. Returns headline, summary, source, and URL. Example: get_company_news({ symbol: "AAPL", from: "2024-01-01", to: "2024-01-31" })

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Get upcoming and recent earnings reports. Pass `symbol` for one company's earnings dates, or omit it for the whole market. Optionally filter by date range. Example: get_earnings_calendar({ symbol: "CRM", from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-06-30" })

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "CRM". Omit for the market-wide calendar.

tools.name: get_earnings_surprises
tools.description: EPS actual vs analyst (consensus) estimate, beat or miss, for a company's recent quarters — the "earnings surprise" history. Returns per quarter: fiscal period, EPS actual, EPS estimate, surprise amount and percent. Revenue is NOT included (Finnhub's earnings-surprise data is EPS-only); for revenue estimates on upcoming quarters, see get_earnings_calendar. Example: get_earnings_surprises({ symbol: "MSFT", limit: 4 })

limit.description: Number of most-recent quarters to return (default 4, max 20)

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

tools.name: get_recommendation_trends
tools.description: Analyst recommendation trends for a company — counts of Strong Buy / Buy / Hold / Sell / Strong Sell, by month, for the last several months. Example: get_recommendation_trends({ symbol: "AAPL" })

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

tools.name: get_price_target
tools.description: Analyst price-target consensus for a company — high, low, mean, and median 12-month price targets, and when they were last updated. Requires your own PAID Finnhub API key with price-target access, passed as _apiKey — Pipeworx's shared key is on a lower plan and cannot reach this endpoint. For free analyst buy/hold/sell trends without a key requirement beyond the shared one, use get_recommendation_trends instead. Example: get_price_target({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your_finnhub_key" })

_apiKey.description: Your own Finnhub API key on a PAID plan that includes price-target data (finnhub.io/pricing). The shared Pipeworx key is on a lower plan and cannot reach this endpoint, unlike the other tools in this pack. Free analyst buy/hold/sell trends are available without this via get_recommendation_trends.

tools.name: finnhub_search_symbol
tools.description: Search for stock ticker symbols by company name or keyword. Returns matching symbols with descriptions. Example: search_symbol({ query: "apple" })

query.description: Search query — company name or keyword, e.g. "apple", "tesla"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-finnhub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the finnhub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
